parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A Fibonacci sequence is a series of numbers formed by adding together the two preceding
numbers, for example:
0, 1, 1, 2, …
This function calculates and returns values in the Fibonacci sequence and uses recursion.
FUNCTION Fib(Number : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
IF Number <= 1 THEN
Result ← Number
ELSE
Result ← Fib(Number – 1) + Fib(Number – 2)
ENDIF
RETURN Result
ENDFUNCTION
